def load(dates, tag):
    out = np.empty((len(dates), 60, 60), dtype=np.float64)
    t0 = time.time()
    for i, dd in enumerate(dates):
        p = f"{base}/sst_{dd.strftime('%Y%m%d')}.nc"
        ds = xr.open_dataset(p, engine="h5netcdf")
        out[i] = ds.analysed_sst[0, SL[0], SL[1]].values
        ds.close()
        if i % 400 == 0 or i == len(dates)-1:
            print(tag, i, "of", len(dates), "elapsed %.1fs" % (time.time()-t0), flush=True)
    return out

# wrap-around centred 31-day moving mean (d-15..d+15 mod 366)
def smooth31(A):  # A: (366, 60, 60)
    A3 = np.concatenate([A, A, A], axis=0)   # 3*366
    # S[d] = mean(A3[d+15-15 : d+15+16]) for d in 0..365 using window start index d (in middle copy)
    starts = np.arange(366) + 1              # window over A3[starts+d ... ] ; want A2[(d-15)..(d+15)]
    # simpler: pad = np.concatenate([A[351:], A, A[:15]])  -> window [d .. d+30]
    pad = np.concatenate([A[366-15:], A, A[:15]], axis=0)  # 366+30
    csum = np.nancumsum(pad, axis=0)
    cnt  = np.cumsum(np.isfinite(pad), axis=0)
    S = np.empty_like(A)
    for d in range(366):
        seg = csum[d+30] - (csum[d-1] if d > 0 else 0)
        n   = cnt[d+30] - (cnt[d-1] if d > 0 else 0)
        S[d] = seg / n
    return S

# verify hazen manual (HF type 5: 1-based k = n*p + 0.5)
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
def hazen_manual(v):
    x = np.sort(v[np.isfinite(v)]); n = len(x)
    if n == 0: return np.nan
    k = n*0.9 + 0.5          # 1-based position
    lo1 = int(np.floor(k))   # 1-based index of lower
    if lo1 >= n: return x[-1]
    g = k - lo1
    return x[lo1-1] + (x[lo1]-x[lo1-1])*g if lo1 < n else x[-1]

    pad = np.concatenate([A[366-15:], A, A[:15]], axis=0)
    csum = np.nancumsum(pad, axis=0)
    cnt  = np.cumsum(np.isfinite(pad), axis=0)
    S = np.empty_like(A)
    for d in range(366):
        seg = csum[d+30] - (csum[d-1] if d > 0 else 0)
        n   = cnt[d+30]  - (cnt[d-1] if d > 0 else 0)
        S[d] = seg / n
    return S

THR_s = smooth31(THR); CLI_s = smooth31(CLI)
print("post-smooth NaN on sea cells: thr", int(np.isnan(THR_s[:,sea]).sum()), "cli", int(np.isnan(CLI_s[:,sea]).sum()))
np.savez_compressed("/tmp/mhw/thrcli.npz", THR=THR_s, CLI=CLI_s, THR0=THR, CLI0=CLI, sea=sea)
print("saved. thr(C) range:", np.nanmin(THR_s)-273.15, np.nanmax(THR_s)-273.15)
